SheetJS Community Edition 0.20.3, unmodified except for the file name of `cpexcel.cjs`
(`dist/cpexcel.js` upstream). Apache-2.0, see LICENSE.

From https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz

It lives here because SheetJS no longer publishes to npm, and Harness's pnpm refuses a
plugin whose dependency comes from a URL (ERR_PNPM_EXOTIC_SUBDEP).
